Ah I see that makes sense! I intentionally separated my tsx files but for those cases you've described, yes this makes sense

@trotyl I have not see any resource, document on angular.io about using angular with tsx. Is this possible? I found myself often use inline template  but it cannot be formatted by prettier. Can't wait for this PR being merged.

@sandangel Using tsx in Angular project does not mean using tsx to create component view, they're different tickets. You can combine Angular with any other libraries or making your own extensions. (But allowing `.tsx` suffix is the basis for all other enhanced)
